title: finding my JOY at @JOY: A New True Musical 🫧 #betsywolfe #joymangano ...
transcript: tonight I am finding my joy and that joy is Betsy Wolfe I finally saw joy the musical at the Laura Pels Theatre and let's just say #mopgirlsummer is it joy the musical is the true heartfelt story of inventor Joy Mangano Joy was a single mom living in Long Island struggling to get by until she invented the miracle mop she became the queen of QVC and a self made millionaire it's a wild and inspiring story about self empowerment and believing in yourself and is also a really beautiful family story about mothers and daughters and Betsy Wolfe was literally made to play this role she brings the perfect mix of warmth and humor and of course her insane vocals also you might get a free mop I did not so now I have to go back we went on National Day of joy and they gave us intermission ice cream and that did in fact bring me so much joy but if you wanna see a musical about strong women chasing their dreams with an incredible cast and fun music then you gotta go see joy this is the perfect show to go with a group of friends your mom your grandma go see Betsy Wolfe do what she does best we just love #mopgirlsummer
